leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the animated series specials in ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the animated series specials in ( ).

==Pokémon Chronicles==
 

==Dedicated releases==
===Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation===
 
The Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation VHS was released in the United Kingdom in 2001 by with the catalogue number S021920. It contains four Pikachu shorts: Christmas Night, Kanga Games, Winter Games, and Stantler's Little Helpers.

It was released as part of a promotion at some retailers in the United Kingdom, where customers would obtain the promotional card and a VHS with the purchase of the VHS or DVD, which was released on October 8, 2001.

 

===Mewtwo Returns===
Mewtwo Returns was released by on VHS in the United Kingdom on February 11, 2002 with the catalogue number S022141.

A Mewtwo Returns VHS box set was also released with the catalogue number S022543 that contains both the Mewtwo Returns VHS and the Indigo League VHS "The Great Race". The two VHS tapes have their own cases.

 

===Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness===
Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time & Darkness was released on DVD in the United Kingdom as a promotional item. The disc came in a DVD case.

It was available as part of a goodie bag with an event in the United Kingdom. It was also available as a bonus for customers that purchased Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Darkness, Pokémon Diamond, or Pokémon Pearl at .

 

==As bonus content==
===Pikachu shorts===
Pikachu shorts are occasionally included in the same release as Pokémon movies on VHS and DVD.
